title: Structuring Complex Multi-Clause Periods with Correlative Pronouns

sections.title: Correlative Pronoun Pairs
sections.content: You know *mert* from A1 Unit 24. Hungarian achieves high textual cohesion by anchoring subordinate clauses with demonstratives in the main clause: *azért..., mert...* (for that reason... because), *úgy..., ahogy...* (in such a way... as) and *akkor..., amikor...* (then... when).

items.spanish: Pontosan azért érvelünk így, mert a jövő biztonsága a célunk.
items.english: We argue in this manner precisely because our goal is the safety of the future.

items.spanish: A dolgok úgy alakultak, ahogy a szakértők előre jelezték.
items.english: Matters unfolded just as the experts had predicted.

items.spanish: Akkor döntünk, amikor minden adat megvan.
items.english: We will decide when all the data is there.
